worldcombat.skill.scaleshot.summary: Shakes the back scales loose and fires them one after another, two to five strikes in a row; when the volley ends the user's Speed rises one stage and Defense falls one. The spray form splits the scales among a group ahead, at lighter per-shard power and a deeper exposed Defence.
worldcombat.skill.scaleshot.use.0: A burst of shards that whittles a target at mid-long range
worldcombat.skill.scaleshot.use.1: Wind up a burst of small hits to raise Speed for the next play
worldcombat.skill.scaleshot.use.2: Spray form to share the shards among a group ahead
Each shard deals %1$s physical damage and the volley fires %2$s shards (2-5 natively, set by the user's data).
A shard leaves every %1$s at %2$s blocks/tick, reaching %3$s blocks with up to ±%4$s spread.
Each shard has a %1$s block hit radius; when the volley ends the user gains Speed +%2$s and loses Defense %3$s stage(s).
worldcombat.skill.scaleshot.spray.on: Spray form: shards take turns among up to %1$s foes in a cone ahead; per-shard power x0.82, one more Defense stage lost, range x0.9, wind-up +2 ticks and interval +1 tick.
worldcombat.skill.scaleshot.spray.off: Focused form: the whole burst chases one target at heavier per-shard power, longer range and a faster cast, but reaches no one else.
worldcombat.skill.scaleshot.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.scaleshot.growth.0: From level %1$s the per-shard power rises to %2$s and the burst grows to %3$s shards.
worldcombat.skill.scaleshot.growth.1: From level %1$s the per-shard power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.scaleshot.preference.s: On: shards take turns among up to 3 foes in a cone ahead for wide coverage; costs per-shard power x0.82, one more Defense stage, range x0.9, wind-up +2 ticks and interval +1 tick. Off (focused): the whole burst chases one target at heavier per-shard power, longer range and a faster cast.
worldcombat.skill.scaleshot.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger opens the volley from farther.
On (with the spray form): ranks a target higher when two or more foes crowd it so the shards cover one more; off: plain mid-range ordering.
On: low-health targets rank higher so a burst finishes them; off: all targets score the same.
